petitionNoChildren.name: Petition for Dissolution of Marriage (Without Minor Children)

petitionWithChildren.name: Petition for Dissolution of Marriage (With Minor Children)

healthInsuranceNotice.name: Notice of Right to Convert Health Insurance

pipOrder.name: Order and Notice to Attend Parent Information Program (PIP)

residencyRequirements.description: At least one spouse must have been domiciled in Arizona for at least 90 days (3 months) immediately preceding the commencement of the action. There is no separate county residency requirement.

waitingPeriod.description: Court may not enter decree until 60 days after service of petition and summons on Respondent.

noFault.name: Irretrievably Broken
noFault.description: The marriage is irretrievably broken with no reasonable prospect of reconciliation

covenantMarriage.note: Covenant marriages have different grounds and require proof of fault or other specific circumstances

preliminaryInjunction.description: Arizona requires a Preliminary Injunction (DR14f) to be filed with every dissolution petition
restrictions: Cannot transfer, encumber, conceal, or dispose of property except in usual course of business
Cannot harass, annoy, or interfere with the other party
Cannot remove minor children from Arizona without written consent or court order
Cannot deny other parent access to minor children

parentInformationProgram.description: Both parents must attend the Parent Information Program (PIP) when minor children are involved

font.family: Proportionally spaced serif font (Times New Roman preferred)

formattingRequirements.pageNumbers: Required on all pages except first
formattingRequirements.notes: Per Arizona Superior Court Administrative Order

inState.description: Exclusive of service date; default after 24 days

outOfState.description: Exclusive of service date; default after 34 days

legalCitations.code: Arizona Rules of Family Law Procedure

filingFees.notes: Maricopa County charges approximately $349-$360 for a Petition for Dissolution of Marriage per Supreme Court Administrative Order 2024-210. Fees vary by county. Response fee is approximately $279. Fee deferral or waiver available for qualifying individuals.

factors: Standard of living during the marriage
Age, employment history, earning ability, and health of spouse seeking maintenance
Ability of spouse to pay maintenance
Contribution to earning ability of other spouse
Extent to which spouse seeking maintenance reduced income for marital responsibilities
Ability of both to contribute to future education of children
Financial resources of spouse seeking maintenance
Time to acquire sufficient education or training for employment
Excessive or abnormal expenditures or destruction of property

propertyDivision.description: Arizona is a community property state. The court shall divide community property equally (50/50), with narrow judicial authority to deviate upon a showing of sound reason. This is NOT equitable distribution — equal division is the presumption.
